Programming Language Reference: Java
Version: Java SE 21 / 22 (LTS)
Syntax: Class-centric object-oriented syntax running on the Java Virtual Machine (JVM).
Semantics: Compiled to bytecode, JIT-compiled at runtime, strictly object-oriented with primitive value types.
Type System: Static, strong, nominal subtyping with interfaces, class inheritance, and type erasure generics.
Memory Model: JVM generational garbage collection (G1, ZGC, Shenandoah) with Java Memory Model (JMM) happens-before guarantees.
Concurrency: Project Loom Virtual Threads, synchronized blocks, java.util.concurrent executors, locks, and atomic variables.
Error Handling: Checked and unchecked exceptions derived from Throwable (Exception vs RuntimeException).
Standard APIs: java.util.List, java.util.Map, java.util.stream.Stream, java.nio.file.Files
Specification: The Java Language Specification (JLS, Oracle)
Official Docs: https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/21/
